Theodora Part 2 Chapter 6 reached the next battle after this restriction was manually cleared; automatic Chapter 6 entry enables it for all four routes and passed the focused Theodora retest. The reverse Disable effect has not been game-tested.

This is not an isolated lower-toggle test.

a9d310ac.name: 行動範囲制限_富裕区-商業区
